scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##GET_INBOUND_FILES') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##GET_INBOUND_FILES

  CREATE TABLE ##GET_INBOUND_FILES(
   [FILEIMPORT_IID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
   [FILEIMPORT_FILENAME] [varchar](300) NULL,
   
   [FILEIMPORT_IMPORTDATE] [datetime] NULL   
  
  )

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS VARCHAR(250) = @GenesysCloudCallLists

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#GCCL') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GCCL
CREATE TABLE #GCCL (CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4))
WHILE (SELECT LEN(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS))>0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #GCCL (CALLLIST_CD) SELECT REPLACE(LEFT(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS,4),',','')
	SET @GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS = RIGHT(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS,LEN(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS)-3)
	IF LEFT(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS,1) = ','
	BEGIN
		SET @GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS = RIGHT(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS,LEN(@GENESYSCLOUDCALLLISTS)-1)
	END
END

DECLARE @EXPORTEDFILES TABLE (FILENAME VARCHAR(200))
DECLARE @DATE DATETIME
SET @DATE = CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,GETDATE())>20 THEN GETDATE() ELSE DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) END)

IF Datename(weekday, @DATE)<>'SUNDAY'
BEGIN

INSERT INTO @EXPORTEDFILES (FILENAME) 
SELECT FILEEXPORT_FILENAME 
FROM PDS_FILEEXPORT
WHERE CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE) > 20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE) ELSE FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE END) = CONVERT(DATE,@DATE)
    AND (FILEEXPORT_FILENAME LIKE 'PDS_Outbound_%' OR FILEEXPORT_FILENAME LIKE 'CMENR_Outbound_%')

--DELETE CALL LISTS FROM EXPORTED FILES IF THEY HAVE MOVED TO GENESYS CLOUD AND INBOUND FILES ARE NOT EXPECTED
DELETE E
FROM @EXPORTEDFILES E
	INNER JOIN #GCCL GC ON SUBSTRING(E.FILENAME,CASE WHEN LEFT(E.FILENAME,3)='PDS' THEN 14 ELSE 16 END,3) = GC.CALLLIST_CD

DECLARE @MISSINGCOUNT INT,@MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR VARCHAR(100)
SELECT @MISSINGCOUNT = COUNT(*) FROM @EXPORTEDFILES E LEFT OUTER JOIN ##GET_INBOUND_FILES I ON REPLACE(E.FILENAME,'Outbound','Inbound') = I.FILEIMPORT_FILENAME 
WHERE FILEIMPORT_IID IS NULL

--Below used for testing success
--SET @MISSINGCOUNT = 0
SET @MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@MISSINGCOUNT)

EXEC('DECLARE @M INT,@TABLENAME VARCHAR(100);SET @M = ' + @MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR + ';SET @TABLENAME = CASE WHEN @M = 0 THEN ''PDS_CALLLIST'' ELSE ''FAIL'' END;EXEC(''SELECT TOP 1 CALLLIST_IID FROM '' + @TABLENAME)')

END

IF Datename(weekday, @DATE)='SUNDAY'
BEGIN

DECLARE @IMPORTEDFILES TABLE (FILEIMPORT_FILENAME VARCHAR(200),FILEIMPORT_IID VARCHAR(30))
INSERT INTO @IMPORTEDFILES (FILEIMPORT_FILENAME,FILEIMPORT_IID) 
SELECT FILEIMPORT_FILENAME,FILEIMPORT_IID
FROM ##GET_INBOUND_FILES
WHERE (FILEIMPORT_FILENAME LIKE 'PDS_Inbound_%')

INSERT INTO @EXPORTEDFILES (FILENAME) 
SELECT FILEEXPORT_FILENAME 
FROM PDS_FILEEXPORT
WHERE CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE) > 20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE) ELSE FILEEXPORT_EXPORTDATE END) = CONVERT(DATE,@DATE-2)
    AND (FILEEXPORT_FILENAME LIKE 'PDS_Outbound_%')

--DELETE CALL LISTS FROM EXPORTED FILES IF THEY HAVE MOVED TO GENESYS CLOUD AND INBOUND FILES ARE NOT EXPECTED
DELETE E
FROM @EXPORTEDFILES E
	INNER JOIN #GCCL GC ON SUBSTRING(E.FILENAME,CASE WHEN LEFT(E.FILENAME,3)='PDS' THEN 14 ELSE 16 END,3) = GC.CALLLIST_CD

DECLARE @MISSINGCOUNT_SUN INT,@MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR_SUN VARCHAR(100)

SELECT @MISSINGCOUNT_SUN = COUNT(*) FROM @EXPORTEDFILES E LEFT OUTER JOIN @IMPORTEDFILES I ON REPLACE(E.FILENAME,'Outbound','Inbound') = replace(replace(I.FILEIMPORT_FILENAME ,left(RIGHT(I.FILEIMPORT_FILENAME ,14),10),dateadd(dd, -1, cast(REPLACE(left(RIGHT(I.FILEIMPORT_FILENAME ,14),10),'_','-') as date))),'-','_')--I.FILEIMPORT_FILENAME 
WHERE FILEIMPORT_IID IS NULL

--Below used for testing success
--SET @MISSINGCOUNT = 0
SET @MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR_SUN = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@MISSINGCOUNT_SUN)

EXEC('DECLARE @M INT,@TABLENAME VARCHAR(100);SET @M = ' + @MISSINGCOUNTVARCHAR_SUN + ';SET @TABLENAME = CASE WHEN @M = 0 THEN ''PDS_CALLLIST'' ELSE ''FAIL'' END;EXEC(''SELECT TOP 1 CALLLIST_IID FROM '' + @TABLENAME)')

	
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##GET_INBOUND_FILES') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##GET_INBOUND_FILES

END
